text:
**Short answer:** For most runners, I'd pick the Shokz OpenFit 2 if you want the best runner-focused option, or the Soundcore AeroFit 2 if you want a good fit for less money. I could only read one of the review pages, SoundGuys. Runner's World and WIRED wouldn't load, so the picks below rest on SoundGuys and the search snippets.

**Top picks for running**

| Pick | Price (sale / list) | Why it suits running |
|---|---|---|
| **Shokz OpenFit 2** | about $180 | SoundGuys describes it as the best choice for endurance athletes. It has about 11 hours of battery and physical buttons you can use with gloves. |
| **Soundcore AeroFit 2** (best budget) | $79.99 / $99.99 | The hooks adjust to four positions for a secure fit. It has an IP55 rating for sweat and rain, multipoint pairing and many EQ presets. The touch controls are overly sensitive. One owner reported about 6 hours of real-world battery against the 10 hours claimed. |
| **HUAWEI FreeClip 2** (best clip-on) | $199.99 | It's light, has an IP57 rating, and can be worn on either ear. It has strong battery life and better bass than most clip-ons. It's pricey and blocks no outside noise. |
| **Nothing Ear (Open)** | $99 / $149 | It has strong bass for an open design and an IP54 rating. Battery life is long. |
| **Sony LinkBuds Open** | about $158 / $230 | It has long battery life and a flexible stabilizer fin. Its water resistance is IPX4-equivalent. |

**Other options**
- **Shokz OpenRun Pro 2** is the bone-conduction choice. The search results include a WIRED review and an RTINGS comparison against the Bose, but I couldn't read either. Runner's World's headline says almost every NYC marathoner was wearing Shokz.
- **Bose Ultra Open Earbuds** cost $299, which SoundGuys calls expensive.
- **Apple AirPods 4** are SoundGuys' pick for iPhone users. They have an IP54 rating but only one size, so try them before buying.

**Which to choose**
- **Best overall for runners:** Shokz OpenFit 2.
- **Best value:** Soundcore AeroFit 2.
- **Very sweaty or rainy runs:** HUAWEI FreeClip 2 for its IP57 rating.

**Links:** I don't have verified direct store links for these. The best source I read is SoundGuys' roundup, which links to retailers: https://www.soundguys.com/best-open-ear-headphones-and-earbuds-115102/

A search result from Dealectric (dealectric.com) advertised a discount code on the AeroFit 2. It listed the earbuds at $129.99, which doesn't match SoundGuys' $99.99 list price. I couldn't verify it, so I'd check the price at Soundcore's own store or Amazon before using it.

Prices change often. Confirm the current price at checkout.
